newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates narrowly mixed, no trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates narrowly mixed, no trade.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were narrowly mixed on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session Thursday. No barges traded versus none Wednesday.
- Two barges, Mississippi River (St Paul-Savage), next week, bid 135 percent of tariff-down 2-1/2 percentage points, no offer.
- Six barges, Mississippi (St.Paul-Savage), three each weeks of July 20 and 27, next week, bid 137-1/2 percent - up 2-1/2 percentage points.
- Four barges, lower Ohio, one each week of September, bid 170 percent - no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week of September, bid 170 percent - no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, mid Mississippi, one each week of September, bid 145 percent - unchanged, no offer.
- Four barges, mid Mississippi (McGregor and south), two each weeks of Sept 21 and 28, bid 210 percent - up 2-1/2 points, no offer.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week of November, bid 180 percent - up five points, offered 190 - up five points.
